tijori.business_description: MV Electrosystems Ltd., incorporated in 2009, designs, develops, assembles, and manufactures electrical and power electronics equipment for railway rolling stock. Its business operates across propulsion equipment and cable protection & management products, supported by in-house R&D and manufacturing capabilities.
